name: Akatoki Nozomi
source:
A magical girl who opposes Yumeha and Kyo, having aligned herself with the Ralpha side.

"So you're asking me to cooperate?
For the two of us to walk hand in hand toward ruin?
No—because that’s wrong. That’s exactly why I’m trying to set things right."
